lines.text: The root is Cede! Precede, concede.
Did you know? Cede is Latin for go.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus go?

words.ex: The crisis was preceded by a period of rapid growth.
The report concedes that the costs were higher than predicted.

publish.title: Cede root: precede and concede
publish.value: Cede comes from Latin "cedere" (to go, to yield). Words: precede and concede. precede = pre + cede; concede = con + cede.
